classificationReason: Provider-only authorization, safe projections, notification mutations, empty/filter behavior, AR/EN direction, and focused accessibility checks pass. Visual closure remains open because the no-update desktop snapshot compares a 1280x761 runtime with an existing 1280x881 baseline; the shared Provider shell is outside this lane.

runtime.authorization: Anonymous sessions do not load provider data; notification read mutations fail closed for a non-provider role and map 401/403/404 responses to safe feedback.
runtime.projection: Only contract-projected notification fields render; internalNotes, assignedTo, auditData, storageKey, accessToken, and refreshToken are absent from the checked DOM.
runtime.navigationAndFocus: Same-origin notification links preserve the provider path and locale; AR/EN E2E checks focus the read action and verify direction.

repairs.defect: Notification links were not explicitly fail-closed for malformed or cross-origin values.
repairs.effect: Invalid, empty, and cross-origin values produce no link; approved same-origin paths receive the locale query.

repairs.defect: An unread-filter response with no rows could hide the filter toolbar as a top-level empty state.
repairs.effect: The unread filter preserves its tabs and empty message while the all-notifications zero-total response uses the page empty state.

repairs.defect: Mutation handlers did not re-check the current provider role before invoking an action source.
repairs.effect: Read and mark-all handlers return a permission feedback state without issuing a mutation when the session is no longer a provider.

verification.command: npm.cmd run test:vitest --workspace apps/web -- tests/provider-notifications-settings.vitest.test.tsx --run -t "uses only|for ar|for en|permission state|fails closed|renders empty|maps notification|honors server|maps settings|contact fields"

verification.result: Functional assertions before the screenshot passed; the no-update snapshot failed at 1280x761 versus the existing 1280x881 baseline for AR and EN.
